key_insight: DRBench Pro evaluates deep research reports by structured knowledge coverage, distinguishing breadth across research directions from depth along related knowledge chains.
engineering_relevance: Agent developers can use separate breadth and depth scores to diagnose coverage gaps that aggregate report-quality ratings may obscure.
method: Build local knowledge trees from Wikipedia and sample subgraphs to generate research queries.
Create evidence-grounded rubrics tied to tree relations; agents receive only the query.
Measure breadth and depth, then combine them using their geometric mean.
evidence_signal: Across 144 cases in 24 domains with 44,102 rubrics, 16 agents were evaluated; the best achieved 57.04% overall coverage, with close human agreement on rubric judgments and stable rankings across tested metric configurations.
watch_item: Wikipedia-derived knowledge trees may not capture specialized, emerging, or non-encyclopedic research knowledge.
paper_title: DRBench Pro: A Knowledge-Centric Benchmark for Professional Deep Research Agents
